podcast.body: The band made this third album at Blackbird studio in Nashville, a conscious decision to avoid the numerous distractions of Los Angeles and focus intently on the music. This creative period followed a critical family intervention prompted by their mother's concern over their unhealthy appearance after a tour, leading the band to "chill out" and prioritize their well-being. The album surprisingly debuted at number one in Russia. "we really just got to focus on the music and the kind of record we wanted to make. And that was because of the times."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Kings of Leon in Their Own Words: Part 2

podcast.body: This was Kings of Leon's third full-length album. It was released in 2007 and, like their other full albums, followed the band's self-imposed rule of having a five-syllable title. "We'll pick things up with a third album because of the Times, because of the Five Cylables, which came out in 2007."
